description: Habits (docs/habits.md, supabase/migrations/0010_habits.sql). A habit has a cadence (daily; weekdays, with 'weekdays' a bitmask Monday 1, Tuesday 2, Wednesday 4 ... Sunday 64; per_week or per_month, with 'times' N), a measure (check: a day is met by a check-in of value 1 or more; count and amount: by a day's value reaching 'target') a 'direction' (at_least: the target is something to reach, the default a habit without the field has; at_most: the target is a limit, which only a daily or weekday habit can be) and 'startsOn'. Under a limit, a day is kept unless a check-in goes over the number (a check habit's limit is none at all, so any check-in goes over), a day nobody logged is kept, a pause or a skip is read before the day is judged, and going over misses the day at once, today included. 'over': whether the day went over the limit, which is what turns the ring and the day red. 'due': whether the habit is due on 'day' (weekly and monthly habits are due any day). 'periods': the first and last day of the habit's period holding 'day' (the day; the week from its Monday; the month). 'states': the state of the period starting on 'period', the first that applies of: none (it ends before startsOn, or a day that isn't due), met (days met in it, not skipped, reach 1, or N for a week or month), paused (a pause overlaps it; 'until' null is open-ended), skipped (a check-in in it is skipped), open (it ends on or after 'today'), missed. 'streaks': met periods counted back from the one holding 'today'; open, paused, skipped and none periods are passed over, the first missed one ends it, and it stops before startsOn. 'heat': a day's heatmap value: null before startsOn or when not due, 'paused' in a pause, 'skipped' for a skipped check-in, else the day's value against its target from 0 to 1 (a check is 0 or 1). 'rings': today's ring: the day's value against the target for daily and weekday habits (null when today isn't due), days met so far against N for weekly and monthly ones, at most 1. 'checkinIds': the name-based UUID of 'checkin/<habit id, lowercase>/<day>' in namespace b8c61b22-5e0c-4f0a-9d1e-6f4a2c7e3b91 (a day's one check-in). 'goalAmounts': the check-in values that count toward a numeric goal: habits serving the goal, measured by count or amount, whose unit is the goal's once both are lowercased without spaces, check-ins not skipped, on a day in the goal's period, in input order. 2026-09-18 is a Friday. 'onToday': whether the habit is due on 'today' ('due': not archived, started on or before today, due that day, and not in a pause) and whether Today shows it ('onToday': due, and 'showOnToday' is not false; a habit without the field shows). A habit kept off Today is still due: the Habits page, the Places hub, stats, reviews and goals count it as before. 'groups': which group of the Habits page a habit sits in: 'limits' for a limit (at_most), 'weekly' for a weekly or monthly habit, 'days' for the rest (every day, or chosen weekdays). 'standings': where a habit stands on 'today', the first that applies of: none (archived, not started, or not due that day), paused (a pause covers today), skipped (a check-in in the period holding today is skipped), limit (a limit is never done or left, so it never reads as not done), done (today's ring is full, or a weekly or monthly habit's check-in today meets its day), left. Hide done hides the done ones, and Today's 'left' count counts the left ones. 'dots': a day of the week's dots on a habit card: none (before startsOn, or a day that isn't due), paused, skipped, then for a limit over (a check-in over the number), open (today) or met; for the rest met (the day is met), open (today), none (a weekly or monthly habit's day without one, which misses nothing) or missed. 'allDone': whether Today shows its 'all done' card for the habits on it, from their standings: none is left and at least one is done.
